title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: plan member waiver cover for HMO straight-tip catheter charges
content:
A non-covered straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) charge on the Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program rests on the plan member waiver the customer signed.

For a straight-tip catheter charge on the Commercial HMO tier that this policy settles, and only for such a charge, the notice that counts is the customer's current plan member waiver for the straight-tip catheter, the one with the latest notice date, which replaces every earlier waiver: the charge is owed only when that waiver was signed on or before the ship date, and the waiver limits the units charged as this policy states; every other non-covered item charge still requires a liability notice signed on or before the ship date covering that item and at least those units.

## Waiver cover

| Current straight-tip plan member waiver | Units charged |
|---|---|
| none stands on the program | the units charged are replaced by none: the amount is Larkfield's write-off |
| dated after the refill's ship date | the units charged are replaced by none: the amount is Larkfield's write-off |
| dated on or before the ship date, and covering fewer units than the refill holds | the units charged are never more than the waiver's units |
| dated on or before the ship date, and covering at least the units the refill holds | the units charged are not limited further |

Only the current waiver is read. An earlier waiver signed before the ship date does not count once a later waiver replaces it.

## Cases (hypothetical; refill of 200 units shipped on the 10th, with 50 units charged before this limit)

- Current waiver for 30 units, signed on the 2nd: 30 units charged.
- Current waiver for 80 units, signed on the 2nd: 50 units charged.
- Current waiver for 250 units, signed on the 2nd: 50 units charged.
- An earlier waiver signed on the 2nd and a current waiver signed on the 15th: no unit is charged.
